drhp.business: Restile Ceramics Limited, incorporated as Restile Ceramics Private Limited on 26th May 1986, manufactures and trades vitrified tiles and has done so for the last three decades. Over nearly four decades it has built a market reputation for its unpolished smooth tiles and Industrial Vitrified Tiles. The Company operates in a single reportable segment and positions its distinctive product portfolio to retain its place in the project and industrial segments.

drhp.expansion: The annual report discloses no capex or capacity-expansion project of its own. Management's stated FY 2026-27 priorities are commercial rather than asset-led: strengthening market access, expanding the distribution network and improving network monetisation, while continuing to evaluate M&A opportunities that support those goals. FY 2025-26 revenue growth was attributed to improved capacity utilisation and stronger order execution within the existing asset base rather than to any capacity addition, and management says it will keep focusing on scaling operations and improving capacity …

litigation.note: The related-party / notes bundle records a case filed against the Company in 1997 regarding an alleged sale and lease back of certain fixed assets belonging to the Company. The Company has disputed the veracity of the arrangement, particularly as there was no evidence of appropriate approvals on behalf of the Company; the case is pending adjudication before the High Court and the assets continue in the Company's possession. There is also a contingent-liability caption for income-tax claims against the Company not acknowledged as debts, but its value line did not arrive in the bundle. Read in the governance_entities bundle (Notes to the Financial Statements, contingent liabilities note) rather than in the profile bundle.

risks.note: The auditors issued a Qualified Opinion. Their Basis for Qualified Opinion states the Company has generated negative cashflows from operations in earlier years, incurred substantial operating losses and suffered significant deterioration in the value of assets used to generate cash flows, all of which indicate a material uncertainty in the Company's ability to continue as a going concern for a reasonable period; the financial statements include no adjustments for these uncertainties and the auditors are unable to comment on the impact of the estimate of the loss/reserves as at March 31, 2026. This is the most structural risk disclosed anywhere in the report.
